name: Sheet Pan Pork Meatballs with Yogurt Sauce & Ranch-Baked Broccoli

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 425°F. Coat a large baking sheet pan with a thin layer of oil.
Place ⅔ of the dressing in a medium bowl. Place remaining dressing in a small bowl and set aside for the sauce.

Add broccoli to the medium bowl with the dressing along with salt and pepper. Stir to coat, then transfer broccoli to one half of the baking sheet and spread out in an even layer. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (510 g) bag broccoli florets
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place pork, bread crumbs, and spices in the reserved bowl. Using your hands, mix well to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
340 g lean ground pork
salt
black pepper
⅛ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Using a tablespoon measure, form the pork mixture into rounded meatballs. Arrange on the other half of the baking sheet.

Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, tossing broccoli and turning meatballs halfway through, until meatballs are cooked and broccoli is fork-tender, 15-18 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, add yogurt, salt, and pepper to the small bowl with the dressing. Stir to combine the sauce.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup plain Greek yogurt
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide sauce and broccoli between plates; top sauce with meatballs. Enjoy!
